To export your data and chat history from ChatGPT using native settings, follow these steps on the web or mobile app:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF15f9w7eQM5Ut7KXJ7A6d9yRqkb_TUdf4Sddx5BPyI3iyj8cek5oiZsqMw-MLwUq0NNz_iYoaJU7ANiXqm0_v77A75f1iaeDVqYyZIajPh7geHQF-q2OUuxgSH5USmui9oNOc8CGGiHpPmR3wwrsXCeSHEog5LJp1mAnWGrxux4kd4fKsg1CfgWSQOtc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF13FACUFtnTSVpXdPjobP-9SEkatM0gkYTJH4g0_n7GPI1TinS-wy8_ATrXzA4qgvbFFzAPwA6I0j41zTWvkI3u2ggiNEv9ybIRN11QK6LgUfaDyHJryfmpWeHcdaq8uJyUiRXEQd1GJE8oC_0dSfxrlv-ax9GFxQJxWD6oIqs-WCP0rlAZoM-HWu0lCwHh2SzbQ)

### On the Web

1. Go to [ChatGPT](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHEIkXXbrG0OgJn9Sa2mgJ65KwhMCpMX5vRCqCmSSesRf0p0R9cKKPMvxUVcjDEVEC0Ajqf-dWmBykSkvt8iIZelFjeC8OXURy5feT9W5sb) and sign in.
2. Click your **profile icon** in the bottom-left corner.
3. Select **Settings**.
4. Click **Data controls** in the left sidebar.
5. Click **Export** next to "Export data," then click **Confirm export**.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXlM2ozRAZL5GosfBRGA1ra5WFosMoWTc3Z_LsnWunQsSvz-bJFdAOzt7jIFOzcs8LBrNyjC3TGFqrmr7QpWQ_YjFc32sNiAgBUhGNgk4N60XpoEgbYbOwWDfUUJ_7CX8LphM)

### On Mobile (iOS & Android)

1. Open the **ChatGPT app** and tap your **profile menu/icon**.
2. Open **Settings**.
3. Select **Data controls**.
4. Tap **Export data** (or **Export Data** ) and confirm.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF15f9w7eQM5Ut7KXJ7A6d9yRqkb_TUdf4Sddx5BPyI3iyj8cek5oiZsqMw-MLwUq0NNz_iYoaJU7ANiXqm0_v77A75f1iaeDVqYyZIajPh7geHQF-q2OUuxgSH5USmui9oNOc8CGGiHpPmR3wwrsXCeSHEog5LJp1mAnWGrxux4kd4fKsg1CfgWSQOtc)

### What Happens Next

- **The Email Link:** OpenAI will send a download link to your registered email address (or SMS if you use phone-only sign-in). This can take a few minutes or up to **7 days** for very large accounts.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF15f9w7eQM5Ut7KXJ7A6d9yRqkb_TUdf4Sddx5BPyI3iyj8cek5oiZsqMw-MLwUq0NNz_iYoaJU7ANiXqm0_v77A75f1iaeDVqYyZIajPh7geHQF-q2OUuxgSH5USmui9oNOc8CGGiHpPmR3wwrsXCeSHEog5LJp1mAnWGrxux4kd4fKsg1CfgWSQOtc)
- **Expiration:** The download link is valid for **24 hours** once you receive it.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF15f9w7eQM5Ut7KXJ7A6d9yRqkb_TUdf4Sddx5BPyI3iyj8cek5oiZsqMw-MLwUq0NNz_iYoaJU7ANiXqm0_v77A75f1iaeDVqYyZIajPh7geHQF-q2OUuxgSH5USmui9oNOc8CGGiHpPmR3wwrsXCeSHEog5LJp1mAnWGrxux4kd4fKsg1CfgWSQOtc)
- **Contents:** The downloaded ZIP file contains your chat history (in JSON and HTML formats) along with generated media and files. (Note: As noted by a user on the [OpenAI Community Forum](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrAEBxCJF16n-SHifNb9IjRq5sIvILZ2O79BsD8x2WzKQf2lbxk1mDkhKrtvZXs2e20dkExdm_aSyVBDdnXYgTRmAVA2QgKUaGuHnwNgCcWIVBAH56EDUVVTyfXcYK5DXcYHZTP--1SL8HKWhIFhrGo9yO6sVhkrT405oHcxehPN_-YBMawwVTFVANIfsGWAAGztiWGij2d36nkYaVunMnhzrRm-0Txh7bGdG8aHQ) , the internal structure of the export archive can shift over time).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrAEBxCJF16n-SHifNb9IjRq5sIvILZ2O79BsD8x2WzKQf2lbxk1mDkhKrtvZXs2e20dkExdm_aSyVBDdnXYgTRmAVA2QgKUaGuHnwNgCcWIVBAH56EDUVVTyfXcYK5DXcYHZTP--1SL8HKWhIFhrGo9yO6sVhkrT405oHcxehPN_-YBMawwVTFVANIfsGWAAGztiWGij2d36nkYaVunMnhzrRm-0Txh7bGdG8aHQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF13FACUFtnTSVpXdPjobP-9SEkatM0gkYTJH4g0_n7GPI1TinS-wy8_ATrXzA4qgvbFFzAPwA6I0j41zTWvkI3u2ggiNEv9ybIRN11QK6LgUfaDyHJryfmpWeHcdaq8uJyUiRXEQd1GJE8oC_0dSfxrlv-ax9GFxQJxWD6oIqs-WCP0rlAZoM-HWu0lCwHh2SzbQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXlM2ozRAZL5GosfBRGA1ra5WFosMoWTc3Z_LsnWunQsSvz-bJFdAOzt7jIFOzcs8LBrNyjC3TGFqrmr7QpWQ_YjFc32sNiAgBUhGNgk4N60XpoEgbYbOwWDfUUJ_7CX8LphM)

items.title: What people are saying

I am begging you, export your ChatGPT history this week.

You've spent years telling it about your projects, your health and how you write. All of that lives on OpenAI's servers.

If OpenAI locks, bans or loses your account, you lose those chats with it. You also can't move them to Claude, Gemini or a model on your own laptop.

In ChatGPT, open Settings → Data controls → Export data, and OpenAI emails you a zip of every chat. In Claude, you'll find the same button under Settings → Privacy.

Save the zip on your own drive. Then copy the parts that matter into one plain notes file, so any AI can read it, including the open source model you downloaded last weekend.

The export takes one click and a minute of your time.

Keep your AI memory on a drive you own.
Is there any way to recover the full contents of an extremely long ChatGPT conversation?
PSA: ChatGPT's data export can take days to arrive, and the download link dies 24 hours after it does

You've probably pasted an API key, a password or even a seed phrase into ChatGPT "just to check something." It's all still sitting in your chat history.

Find it in 5 minutes:
1. Export your history (ChatGPT: Settings → Data controls → Export. Claude: Settings → Privacy → Export data)
2. Unzip it, open the folder in Claude Code and paste:

"Scan every conversation in this folder for secrets I pasted: API keys, passwords, private keys, seed phrases (12 or 24 English words in a row), card numbers and ID numbers. For each one, show the chat title, the date and only the first and last 4 characters. Group them into: rotate now, check, and false alarm. Never print a full secret and don't send anything online."

Then change everything in the "rotate now" list.
